items.title: Lifting a syntomic, smooth or etale morphism to a closed subscheme up to a Zariski covering
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a syntomic, smooth or etale morphism U -> X over a closed subscheme X of Y can be covered Zariski locally by base changes of morphisms of the same type over Y (statement lines 6856-6863). The proof reduces to the affine case by locality (proof lines 6865-6875) and then applies the standard lifting result for morphisms of these types along a closed immersion (proof lines 6875-6883), assembling the local pieces into a Zariski covering. The non-formal content is the application of the lifting result. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one assembly.
